name: UOADEV
recent: 近期公告主要是董事Eugene Lee Chin Jin在公开市场增持公司股份，以及EPF Board连续多日的持股变动申报。公司于8月底公布了截至2026年6月30日的季度业绩。
notable: 独立非执行董事Eugene Lee Chin Jin于2026年10月19日及20日分别在公开市场增持157,800股及5,300股普通股。
EPF Board于2026年10月12日至21日期间多次申报持股变动。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly involve Director Eugene Lee Chin Jin acquiring shares in the open market and a series of changes in EPF Board's shareholding. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 in late August.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Eugene Lee Chin Jin acquired 157,800 and 5,300 ordinary shares in the open market on 19 and 20 October 2026 respectively.
EPF Board made multiple shareholding change notifications between 12 and 21 October 2026.
